question: Is SYN-07 safe to fly?
answer: The aircraft SYN-07 is currently on the ground awaiting parts since 2026-08-14 and is marked as "AOG" (Aircraft On Ground). It is awaiting a replacement propeller set that is on order after a ground strike. The workbench does not certify airworthiness.
